summary: Narrow campus service lane between lab buildings; no room to pull off.
reasons: Building to lane edge, no shoulder
Bollard at 12 m, crossing near 50 m
No parked cars; service access only

drivers.seclusion: Enclosed by university lab buildings 5 to 20 m away; no dwellings within 29 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is tight between buildings and trees with no pull-off; a mapped bollard sits 12 m along and a van would block service access.
drivers.traffic: Campus service route through the science precinct; deliveries and foot traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the lane; only a few bays at the south end.

flags: Bollard 12 m from the start; likely restricted vehicle access
Campus working hours activity and likely security
sun_shade: Heavy tree and building shade for most of the length.
